CONMED: Pro Forma Adjustments capped at 15% of Consolidated EBITDA (after giving effect), net of benefits realized
DSGR: Combined Cap 20% of EBITDA before specified add-back clauses
GIB: Section 1.10 aggregate synergy/cost-savings caps combined with sister clauses

GIB uses Consolidated Total Net Leverage Ratio naming with explicit net leverage + Unrestricted Cash mechanics in ratio/pro forma sections

GIB: ECF mandatory prepayment percentage step-DOWN as First Lien Net Leverage improves
